A proposal by Alexx Creative Studio

Told properly.

To build, run and grow the brand that carries this province to the world.

The brief, as we read it

Sell the destination, not the booking.

The work is not to close a sale tonight. It is to make the world want to come here, and to come here first.

  • Reach the traveller still decidingThe international visitor choosing where in Africa to go.
  • Win them to the Eastern Cape firstBefore Kruger, or anywhere else, gets the chance.
  • Position the province, then the 8 reservesThe place sells first. Each member sells next.
The positioning

This is not Kruger. That is the point.

  • Big 5 wilderness, none of the crowdsSpace, silence and the animals to yourselves.
  • No R2 000 gate feesConservation Rands go straight to the land.
  • Malaria-free and simple to reachA real holiday, not a logistics exercise.
The idea

Come for the safari.
Stay for the story.

A site you fall into like a magazine, not a menu you click through. A traveller is won by a feeling, not by a list of facts.
